entities.name: Pedro Afonso, conde de Barcelos
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pedro Afonso, Count of Barcelos, was an illegitimate son of King Denis of Portugal and Grácia Froes. He was made the 3rd Count of Barcelos on 1 May 1314.
